title: Can I MASTER Gothic Chess?
summary: Five online Gothic Chess games vs ~1500 humans on a 10x8 board with two extra compound pieces per side.
rules: Archbishop = bishop + knight moves; Chancellor = rook + knight moves.
Castling (Gothic Chess rules, inferred): king starts on f1/f8; kingside castling puts king on i1 and rook j1->h1; queenside puts king on c1 and rook a1->d1.
Pawns may promote to archbishop or chancellor too.

opponent.name: online human opponents (chess.com Variants)
opponent.avatar_description: generic chess.com user avatar; random human usernames

custom_pieces.name: Archbishop
custom_pieces.look: red compound piece (chess.com icon, crescent/horned top)

setup: Gothic Chess: rnbqckabnr/pppppppppp/10/10/10/10/PPPPPPPPPP/RNBQCKABNR w KQkq - 0 1 (C=Chancellor on e-file, A=Archbishop on g-file, king on f-file).
evidence: Frames (research/frames/visual_*.jsonl): {"start_pieces": "each side: standard pieces + Archbishop + Chancellor on 10-file back rank, 10 pawns", "special": "5-game counter boxes 1-5", "opponent_ui": "humans outis3 (1500?), MR_T09 (1500?)"}.
